description: This file defines the SnakeView class, which implements the core logic and rendering for a snake game. It manages game state, snake movement, apple placement, user interactions, and drawing the game arena.

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.description: Helper class representing x,y positions in the game grid.

methods.name: initSnakeView
methods.description: Initializes the view, loads tiles, and sets up the game.

methods.name: initNewGame
methods.description: Resets game state with initial snake and apples.

methods.name: coordArrayListToArray
methods.description: Converts a list of Coordinates into a flat int array.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Serializes the current game state into a Bundle for persistence.

methods.name: coordArrayToArrayList
methods.description: Restores a list of Coordinates from a flattened int array.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from a Bundle.

methods.name: moveSnake
methods.description: Handles user input to change snake direction and start new games.

methods.name: setDependentViews
methods.description: Links external UI components for displaying status and controls.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Updates game mode and relevant UI visibility.

methods.name: addRandomApple
methods.description: Places a new apple at an unoccupied random position.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Main game loop tick: moves snake, updates display, checks timers.

methods.name: updateApples
methods.description: Draws apples on the game grid.

methods.name: updateSnake
methods.description: Moves the snake, handles collisions, and updates the trail.
